function_v0.doc: Initialise a freshly-deployed scalar-Gaussian market. See the Sprint-1\ndocs; Sprint 2 appends the `usdc` SAC contract id (the settlement asset,\nresolved per-network at deploy time \xe2\x80\x94 never hardcoded).
function_v0.name: init

function_v0.doc: Claim a resolved position: returns `collateral + (g(x\xe2\x82\x80) \xe2\x88\x92 f(x\xe2\x82\x80))`\nclamped at `0` in USDC (floor 7-dp), deletes the position.
function_v0.name: claim

function_v0.doc:
Submit a belief `(\xce\xbc\xe2\x82\x82, \xcf\x83\xe2\x82\x82)`: scale to `\xce\xbb\xe2\x82\x82 = k\xc2\xb7\xe2\x88\x9a(2\xcf\x83\xe2\x82\x82\xe2\x88\x9a\xcf\x80)`, compute the
position `g \xe2\x88\x92 f` and worst-case collateral, add the fee, pull USDC, mint
a position, advance the curve to `g`, return the position id.
`max_collateral_7dp` guards slippage (total = collateral + fee, 7-dp).
function_v0.name: trade

function_v0.doc: After `window.resolve`, pull `x\xe2\x82\x80` from the resolver. `Stale` \xe2\x87\x92 market\nbecomes `Disputable` (no payouts). `Pending` \xe2\x87\x92 reverts\n`ResolverNotReady`. Otherwise `Resolved(x\xe2\x82\x80)` and `claim` opens.
function_v0.name: resolve

function_v0.doc:
Initialise a freshly-deployed trajectory market. `checkpoints` are Unix
timestamps (ascending, \xe2\x89\xa4 `window.resolve`); `mus0`/`sigmas0` are the
initial per-checkpoint Gaussian params (WAD), one per checkpoint. The
\xcf\x83-floor + `peak \xe2\x89\xa4 b` solvency checks apply to every checkpoint.
function_v0.name: init_trajectory

function_v0.doc: Claim a resolved trajectory position: returns `collateral +\n\xce\xa3_i (g_i(x_i) \xe2\x88\x92 f_i(x_i))` clamped at `0` in USDC (floor 7-dp), deletes\nthe position.
function_v0.name: claim_trajectory

function_v0.doc:
Burn LP `shares` and withdraw the proportional slice of `pool + fee_pool`
in USDC. While `Open`, only the slice not reserved for locked trader
collateral is withdrawable. Blocked during `Locked`, `Disputable`, and
after resolution until every position is claimed.
function_v0.name: remove_liquidity

function_v0.doc:
Submit per-checkpoint beliefs `(\xce\xbc_i, \xcf\x83_i)`: for each checkpoint compute
the position `g_i \xe2\x88\x92 f_i` and its worst-case collateral; the trade's
collateral is the sum (the checkpoints are independent \xe2\x87\x92 worst-case of
the sum is the sum of worst-cases). Adds the fee, pulls USDC, mints a
trajectory position, advances every checkpoint curve to `g_i`.
function_v0.name: trade_trajectory

All WAD. `\xce\xbb` is derived and stored\nredundantly so reads never recompute a square root.

The summary the [`Registry`] indexes for each market \xe2\x80\x94 enough for the
frontend's market list without a per-market `get_params` round-trip. The
market contract itself stays the source of truth for live state (belief,
status, pool).

tuple_v0.doc: Resolved; payouts settled. (Carries the realised outcome value, WAD.)

udt_union_v0.doc: The shape of a market's outcome. Sprint 1 ships **scalar** markets only;\ntrajectory markets (a path sampled at checkpoints) land in Sprint 2 (ADR-4)\nas an additional variant \xe2\x80\x94 adding it is non-breaking for existing markets.

tuple_v0.doc:
The outcome is a path sampled at N checkpoint timestamps (Unix
seconds, ascending). The belief is one [`Belief`] per checkpoint; the
checkpoints share one collateral pool (whitepaper \xc2\xa716; ADR-4). v1
treats the per-checkpoint Gaussians as independent.
tuple_v0.name: Trajectory

udt_struct_v0.doc:
A trader's position: the market curve immediately *before* the trade (`f`)
and immediately *after* (`g`), the collateral locked, and the owner \xe2\x80\x94
everything needed to compute the payout `g(x\xe2\x82\x80) \xe2\x88\x92 f(x\xe2\x82\x80)` at resolution
without storing any curve array (ADR-2, whitepaper \xc2\xa711). Used from Sprint 2.
udt_struct_v0.name: PositionData
